description:
The Firmstrong Urban Man Three Speed cruiser bike is a fantastic recreational men’s bike that combines classic style with the added power of gears. True to our signature beach cruiser design, the frame remains simple and clean, offering a timeless aesthetic that looks great whether you are on the boardwalk or a city street.

What sets the Urban Man 3-Speed apart is its Shimano internal gear system, one of the easiest and most reliable setups on the market. Unlike traditional bikes, all the shifting happens inside the rear hub. This means the chain stays put, resulting in a low-maintenance ride with far fewer mechanical headaches. You can even change gears without interrupting your pedal stroke, ensuring a seamless transition every time.

Don’t let the simplicity fool you; these three gears are precision-tuned for the recreational rider’s every need. Gear one offers low resistance, making it ideal for tackling hills with ease. Gear two is perfect for casual cruising at a steady pace of 5 to 15 mph. Gear three is designed for high-speed straightaways and downhill glides, allowing you to hit 15 to 25 mph effortlessly. With only one cable, the design stays uncluttered, keeping that no-frills cruiser look while giving you the versatility to handle more than just flat ground.

The ride is smooth and effortless; our signature wide cruiser tires and dual-spring saddle absorb the bumps of the road, making your journey soft and relaxing. For braking, we’ve kept it classic with a coaster brake, simply pedal backwards to stop, just like the original beach cruisers you remember. Built with a durable steel frame and an ergonomic design, the Urban Man 3-Speed is the perfect upgrade for the rider who wants a bit more capability without the complexity of a multi-speed mountain bike.

19” Steel Frame with 26” Aluminum Wheels

3 Speed Men's Bike with Shimano Internal Gear System, shifts quickly and easily and requires little maintenance

Pedal-Backwards Coaster Brake for easy pedaling and smooth braking

Dual Spring Oversized Seat for Added Comfort

2.125” Wide White-Wall Tires provides a cushioned, relaxed ride for easy rolling

28.5” Wide Cruiser Bike Handlebars with Rubber Grips

Bicycle Weighs approximately 34.5 lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Men 5’2” – 5’11” Tall

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 25mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 35 miles in a single trip

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Color Matched Fenders can be Purchased Separately for $49.99.

Bike comes 80% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA
